plan.title: Convert RFQ to Auction with Cost Breakdown Mode

steps.note: Open the existing RFQ event with vendor quotes that is to be converted.

args.goal: On the converted auction creation screen, open Event Type, choose the option showing Rank on line, enable the checkbox labeled Enable Cost Breakdown Mode, configure the remaining required auction settings with valid values, and stop with the cost breakdown setting visibly enabled.

steps.note: No catalog domain step can select the converted auction's Event Type option or enable Cost Breakdown Mode.
a template comes first on the create screen
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Verify the auction launched as a real published project.
Convert the published RFQ into the auction creation screen.
Have an invited vendor submit a bid in the live auction, representing the lot-level auction submission.
Verify the vendor submission was accepted by the supplier portal.
Check the buyer-facing live auction view for the expected Auto-breakdown submission indicator.
